• Algorithm support - Auto-optimize supports only HNSW-based vector indexes.
• Concurrent jobs - You can run up to 10 concurrent optimization jobs per account per Region. No
new jobs can be accepted if limit is reached.
• Job duration - Optimization jobs can take from 15 minutes to several hours depending on
dataset size, dimension, and required performance metrics.
• Recommendations - Auto-optimize suggests only up to 3 recommendations.
• Dataset
• Supported formats: parquet
• Data store: Amazon S3
